hotels.title: Stylish Seoul Pangyo Stay with Contemporary Comfort and Easy City Access
hotels.description: Set in Pangyo’s tech-forward district, Hyatt Place Seoul Pangyo places you within easy reach of Seoul’s southern business corridor. Spacious rooms feature separate living and sleeping areas, while the hotel’s 24-hour fitness centre and indoor pool cater to busy schedules. Nearby, explore Pangyo Techno Valley, Jeongja Café Street and the boutiques of nearby Seohyeon. The hotel’s Gallery Café serves all-day dining, and the lobby lounge offers drinks and light bites for a relaxed pause between meetings
